{{< include latex-macros/macros.qmd >}}

A reduction turns every question about one problem
into a question about another,
so that a fast algorithm for the second gives one for the first.
Reductions compare the difficulty of the problems in
[NP](p-and-np.qmd#def-class-np), and single out the hardest of them.
